construction: Fifteen original, self-contained CSS recipes. Each recipe uses gradients, color fields, blurred light, circles, rounded slabs, and straight light bars generated in the browser. No raster image, SVG, canvas image draw, gallery URL, direct asset, text, number, UI icon, UI control, dotted arc, or path is used in a background.
inspiration: Theater visual DNA is interpreted at a high level only: copy-safe left fields, an opposite-side compositional mass, material contrast, and role-appropriate intensity. This registry does not reproduce, crop, trace, embed, or reuse Inspiration Theater artwork.

assertions.crossfade: 220ms ease-in-out opacity transition; no blur transition
